create_mlp: create a multi-layer perceptron with specified output sizes and ReLU activation using Haiku
build_mlp_with_custom_activation: build an MLP module using a custom activation function like sigmoid or tanh
run_mlp_forward: run the MLP forward pass on input tensors to get output predictions
create_mlp_with_dropout: create an MLP with optional dropout regularization by passing dropout_rate and rng key
reverse_mlp: reverse an MLP to create a new module that accepts the output and produces the original input size
